$comment: CANONICAL grade->topic catalogue, extracted from MOE Science syllabuses. Regenerate with tools/build_topic_catalog.py after syllabus docs change. NEVER hand-edit codes without also updating tools/build_topic_catalog.py so the two stay consistent. Sources: 'knowledge-base/moe-syllabus/Primary Science Syllabus 2023.pdf' (P3-P6, version 2023) and 'knowledge-base/moe-syllabus/G2-3 Lower Secondary Science Teaching and Learning Syllabus.pdf' (S1/S2 G2-G3 course, implementation from 2024 S1 cohort).
schema_note: grade key -> array of {code, name, theme} where code is a 1-6 char upper-alnum short code used in question_id: Q-<GRADE>-<CODE>-<6chars>.

primary.coverage: P3, P4, P5, P6 ONLY (document is titled 'Primary Three to Six' - it does NOT cover P1/P2)
primary.table_ref: Table 2 p21: 'An Overview of the topics in the Primary Science Syllabus'

lower_secondary.file: knowledge-base/moe-syllabus/G2-3 Lower Secondary Science Teaching and Learning Syllabus.pdf
lower_secondary.coverage: S1, S2 (G2/G3 Lower Secondary course; implementation started with 2024 S1 cohort)
lower_secondary.table_ref: Table 3 p14: 'Overview of the G2/G3 Lower Secondary Science Syllabuses'

NOT_AVAILABLE.P1: No MOE Syllabus 1-2 document in knowledge-base/moe-syllabus/ yet. UI must not offer any P1 topic options until real sources land (unverified guesswork on this topic is a), 'never guess beyond grade level' (context.md product rule 1).
NOT_AVAILABLE.P2: Same status as P1 - no syllabus document supplied yet.
NOT_AVAILABLE.S3: Upper Secondary (S3-S4) splits into separate Physics / Chemistry / Biology subjects; no such doc supplied yet. Dropdown will show 'No syllabus data loaded yet' for these grades.

s1s2_note: Both S1 and S2 share the SAME 16-topic G2/G3 LSS syllabus (Lower Secondary runs as a two-year common 'G2/G3' course, not split by year in the source doc). Both keys therefore map to the same topic array.
